name: Blender Studio first-class AI capability
description: Evidence-first benchmark for AI-native Blender creation, verification, export, and game-engine handoff through Synapse.

scenarios.name: Model and material from brief
scenarios.description: Create an original modeled asset with topology, UVs, PBR material, texture evidence, and render.
scenarios.prompt_md: Create the assigned original 3D asset in Blender. Save a .blend and structural evidence for topology, transforms, UVs, material nodes, texture provenance, and a verification render.
scenarios.reset_procedure_md: Use a fresh Blender file and output directory.

scenarios.name: Procedural Geometry Nodes asset
scenarios.description: Build a nontrivial Geometry Nodes graph and prove evaluated geometry differs from source.
scenarios.prompt_md: Create a reusable Geometry Nodes asset. Save the graph and independently evaluate the generated result after reopen.

scenarios.name: Rig and animation
scenarios.description: Rig a mesh, prove deformation, action/NLA, and animated GLB round trip.
scenarios.prompt_md: Rig and animate the assigned asset. Prove deformation at distinct frames, save action/NLA evidence, export animated GLB, and re-import cleanly.
scenarios.reset_procedure_md: Use fresh Blender and re-import states.

scenarios.name: Multi-format export integrity
scenarios.description: Export GLB, FBX, OBJ, USD and verify each by clean re-import.
scenarios.prompt_md: Export the assigned source asset to GLB, FBX, OBJ, and USD. Re-import each cleanly and report preservation by format.
scenarios.reset_procedure_md: Use a clean import state per format.

scenarios.name: Game-ready asset gate
scenarios.description: Validate scale, transforms, naming, topology/material budgets, collision, and target constraints.
scenarios.prompt_md: Prepare the assigned asset for the stated game engine. Produce an explicit game-readiness receipt and only claim readiness when declared constraints are evidenced.

scenarios.name: Downstream engine handoff
scenarios.description: Import into an available target engine with structural, visual, and playtest/build evidence.
scenarios.prompt_md: Hand the assigned Blender asset to the available target engine. Capture import receipt, structural assertions, visual evidence, and playtest/build status. Treat environment blockers separately from asset failures.
scenarios.reset_procedure_md: Use an isolated target-engine proof project.

scenarios.name: Failure and uncertainty recovery
scenarios.description: Recover from unavailable routes without fabricating completion or destroying user work.
scenarios.prompt_md: Complete the assigned Blender task while one route is unavailable. Use an allowed fallback, preserve original work, record failure, and report only verified capabilities.
